bio.text: Jack Codiga is the Republican candidate for North Carolina's 12th Congressional District in 2026, running against Rep. Alma Adams.
WFAE's voter guide lists him as approximately 28 years old, with no prior elected office, working as an associate producer at Medalist Capital, a mortgage lender.
According to the guide, he moved to Charlotte from California in 2021 and has a bachelor's degree from Santa Clara University.
